name: S2 — a download belongs to the post it happened in
why: A saved download is not a transcript entry of its own: it sits inside the post whose time window contains the moment it finished, within that post's rule, and scrolls with it (1.62.9). A card appended after the conversation would drift away from the work it belongs to.

parts.text: The first report — the browser is fetching the file.
second message, written after the file arrived
